title: 🎨 Designer Sections — split-pane editor with live preview · 实时分屏编辑器
summary:
Products tab modal is now a true magazine editor: left pane = block tabs + form for the selected block; right pane = sticky live phone preview rendering all blocks with the real brand fonts and colors. Edits update the preview as you type.
「产品」模态框升级为真正的杂志式编辑器:左侧块标签 + 当前块表单,右侧粘性手机预览(品牌字体与配色),所见即所得。
